IJR.budget.title: What your amount represents in IJR
IJR.budget.text: If the full amount were used for this asset alone, CAD 4,600.00 corresponds to approximately 22 whole shares at the observed price, leaving CAD 189.40 before fees and currency spreads. This is an indicative sizing calculation, not an order or a forecast. This current-price whole-share estimate is separate from the historical replay, which invests the full stated amount in fractional units at its starting date. It uses the Bank of Canada daily exchange rate dated 2026-11-13; the FX and equity observations are not simultaneous.
